records.title: Main received another scheduled/workflow-run cross-analysis refresh while the write-enabled workflow remains active
records.note: Current main advanced from 3a1b1e7a2cf2a22e262d73592ceec9196356fbae to 541520d7e96b5b86109d5cb6f1549c75fc0262ea with commit message 'Cross-analysis refresh [skip ci]'. The current cross-analysis.yml still has workflow_run on Knowledge Signal Cycle completion for main, hourly cron '50 * * * *' and workflow_dispatch, permissions contents:write, and a step that stages generated files, commits and pushes to main. The commit's exact triggering event was not returned by the inspected commit/workflow-run endpoints, so it cannot be attributed specifically to cron versus workflow_run. PR #1373 remains open/draft/unmerged; its base is 30bd52..., so current main is two commits ahead, with only ping-pongings/knowledge-base/sentiment_shift.json changed relative to that base. PR #1373 exact-head CI and fail-closed gate had passed. PR #1374 is based on 3a1b1e..., so current main is one commit ahead, again only sentiment_shift.json; its exact-head 345-test/8-subtest CI and gate had passed. PR #1373 and #1374 both modify .github/workflows/ci.yml and require sequencing. No merge or dispatch occurred.
